answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with quadratic stake and random liveness audits. Each identity locks jade collateral and gets one attested vote weighted by the square root of its stake, so splitting funds across many wallets cannot multiply influence. Each epoch a random pulse challenge makes an identity sign with its key and reveal its history; misses slash the bond. A falcon auditor samples a few identities cheaply, so faking N agents means keeping N live keys and N bonds: cost grows with N while voting power grows only as the square root of N.
